title: OwnProjects
summary: A personal collection of small and university programming projects by a student, including a 'Black-box PIA' study that generates synthetic tabular data and shadow-model outputs to test membership inference privacy attacks. It uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, guided by a SingleTableMetadata object, to fit and sample synthetic data for these shadow models.
needs: Repository is a personal/student project collection; unclear how central the PIA subproject is to the overall repo goals.
